content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD internal wavemaker module (BSD header L1-44): Wei & Kirby source-function wave generation, 17 subroutines. (1) WAVEMAKER_INITIALIZATION (L55-613, 11/09/2010, separated from INITIALIZATION 02/10/2016) dispatches on WaveMaker string: 'WK_REG' (L67) computes the periodic-boundary-compatible wave angle by scanning discrete transverse wavenumbers tmp2=I*2*pi/DY/(Nglob-1) until ASIN(tmp2/wkn) reaches Theta_WK (L86-187, errors stop the run L95-101,L120-126; a removed Yc_WK redefinition is commented L69-83 per Reniel complaint 07/08/2016) then calls WK_WAVEMAKER_REGULAR_WAVE (L190-191); 'WK_DATA2D' (L196) reads WaveCompFile unit 1 (NumFreq,NumDir L198, PeakPeriod L203, Freq L205, Dire L208, WAVE_COMP L211, optional Phase2D L214 with END=110 flagging INPUT_WAVE_PHASE L229-230), filters directions with |Dire|<60 deg (L236-246), reallocates arrays (L255-260), calls WK_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA (L291-293), converts input phase by *0.005555555555556*pi (=1/180*pi, L299) or assigns random phases rand()*2*pi (INTEL/CRAY/default branches L306-313), sets OMGN2D=2*pi*Freq (L321), FreqPeak=1/PeakPeriod (L324), calls CALCULATE_Cm_Sm (L328-334), keeps Phase2D allocated (comment L339-342); 'WK_TIME' (L351) reads NumWaveComp 3-column series and calls WK_WAVEMAKER_TIME_SERIES (L358-359); 'WK_IRR'/'TMA_1D'/'JON_1D'/'JON_2D' (L370-371) allocates irregular arrays (L375-378) and calls WK_WAVEMAKER_IRREGULAR_WAVE or WK_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE by EqualEnergy flag (L382-395) then CALCULATE_Cm_Sm (L397-402); 'ABS'/'LEFT_BC_IRR' (L415) calls CALCULATE_DATA2D_Cm_Sm for WAVE_DATA_TYPE='DATA' else CALCULATE_TMA_Cm_Sm(_EQUAL_DFREQ) (L416-429); Salatin et al. 2021 (JGR Oceans, doi 10.1029/2021JC017641, comment blocks L433-440, L563-570) additions 'WK_NEW_DATA2D' (L442) reading single-column spectra (L445-465, direction filter |Dire|<=90 L483-492, phase *pi/180 L523, WK_NEW_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA L536-539, CALCULATE_NEW_Cm_Sm L550-556) and 'WK_NEW_IRR' (L572) calling WK_NEW_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE with coherence parameter alpha_c and CALCULATE_NEW_Cm_Sm (L574-599). (2) WK_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA (L627-819, 10/17/2011): converts Dire to radians (L648), for PERIODIC remaps each (freq,dir) to the nearest discrete periodic angle (L652-760, angle1 vs tmp3 choice L735-741); computes per-component Wei-Kirby source: dispersion wkn=SQRT((tc-SQRT(tc*tc-4*alpha1*tb))/(2*alpha1))/h_gen with alpha=-0.39 (L774-775,L792-793), rlamda=wkn*sin(theta) (L798), beta_gen=80.0/delta**2/wave_length**2 (L799), rI=SQRT(3.14159/beta_gen)*exp(-rl_gen**2/4/beta_gen) (L801), D_gen=2*AMP_WK*cos(theta)*(omgn**2-alpha1*grav*wkn**4*h_gen**3)/(omgn*wkn*rI*(1-alpha*(wkn*h_gen)**2)) (L803-805); width=delta*wave_length/2 at PeakPeriod (L810-817). (3) CALCULATE_Cm_Sm (L831-891, 11/9/2010): Cm/Sm(i,j,kf)=SUM_ktheta D_gen*exp(-beta_gen*((I-Ibeg+(iista-1))*DX-Xc)**2)*cos/sin(rlamda*((J-Jbeg+(jjsta-1))*DY)+phi1) — Gaussian source envelope in x at Xc times transverse phase (parallel form L855-872 ykchoi Jan/23/2018 replacing npx*Mglob/px offsets; serial L874-882). (4) CALCULATE_DATA2D_Cm_Sm (L903-1042): allocates Cm_eta..Sm_v (L924-927), Newton-Raphson linear dispersion solve per frequency (labels 55/65, Fk=Grav*k*tanh(k*d)-sigma^2 L937, Fkdif L939-940, tol 1.0e-8 or 1000 iters L938), Zlev=ABS(1+Beta_ref)*Dep_Ser (L960), then eta/u/v Fourier coefficient fields Cm_eta etc. with cosh(kZlev)/sinh(kd) transfer and CalcPeriodicTheta direction correction under PERIODIC (L966-1039). (5) CalcPeriodicTheta (L1053-1174, 09/12/2017): maps input angle to the nearest discrete periodic angle for given WaveNumber, stops if |angle|>=90 deg (L1065-1078); logs to unit 3 (L1157-1170). (6) CALCULATE_TMA_Cm_Sm (L1192-1517, history incl. Geiman/Choi Hmo-Hrms conversion notes L1180-1186) builds TMA/JONSWAP spectrum: 10000-bin scan with Kitaigorodskii factor phi (L1256-1259; phi=1 for 'JON' L1261-1263), sigma_spec=0.07/0.09 split at fm (L1265-1266), Etma=grav**2*fre**(-5)*(2*pi)**(-4)*phi*exp(-5/4*(fre/fm)**(-4))*gamma_spec**exp(...) (L1268-1270), equal-energy frequency selection Ef100=Ef/REAL(mfreq+1) (L1281-1301) with Freq=0 (L1304-1306) and non-monotonic tail (L1313-1315) patches, wrapped-normal directional spreading AG (Borgman 1984, ykchoi 11/07/2016, L1322-1352 with N_spec=20/sigma_theta L1318), alpha_spec=Hmo**2/16/Ef (L1355), Hmo_each=4*SQRT(alpha_spec*Ef100*AG) (L1360), ap=Hmo_each/SQRT(2)/2 Hmo->Hrms conversion (L1374), then per-component Amp_Ser/Wave_Number_Ser/Theta_Ser/Segma_Ser/Per_Ser (L1415-1419) and the same Cm_eta..Sm_v field synthesis (L1437-1512); random Phase_Ser=rand()*2*3.1415926 (L1241-1247). (7) CALCULATE_TMA_Cm_Sm_EQUAL_DFREQ (L1535-1819, 04/14/2017): same but equal frequency spacing df=(fmax-fmin)/(mfreq-1) (L1584), EnergyBin(kff)=Etma*df (L1615-1616), Hmo_each(ktheta,kf)=4*SQRT(alpha_spec*EnergyBin(kf)*AG(ktheta)) (L1663). (8) WK_WAVEMAKER_IRREGULAR_WAVE (L1835-2115): source-function version of (6) producing D_gen/phi1/rlamda/beta_gen/omgn/width for the internal wavemaker; PERIODIC in-loop angle snapping (L2033-2077), rlamda/beta_gen/rI/D_gen (L2081-2089), width from fm (L2095-2100), random phi1 (L2104-2112). (9) WK_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE (L2128-2357, 04/14/2017): equal-df version of (8) (df L2164, EnergyBin L2216-2217, Hmo_each(ktheta,kf) L2227, D_gen L2330-2332). (10) WK_WAVEMAKER_REGULAR_WAVE (L2369-2405, 10/22/2010): single-component Wei-Kirby source (theta=Theta_WK*pi/180 L2378, alpha=-0.39 L2379, wkn L2389-2390, rlamda/width/beta_gen/rI L2394-2398, D_gen L2401-2403). (11) WK_WAVEMAKER_TIME_SERIES (L2417-2472, 04/13/2011): per-component source amplitudes D_gen(I),beta_gen(I) from WAVE_COMP(NumWaveComp,3) with theta=ZERO (L2430); width from PeakPeriod (L2465-2470). (12) VISCOSITY_WMAKER (L2484-2550, 08/19/2015 YoungKwang Choi): inside the wavemaker box |xmk-Xc_WK|<Width_WK and |ymk-Yc_WK|<Ywidth_WK/2 (L2536-2537) sets nu_break=cap1*WAVEMAKER_visbrk*tmp3+nu_bkg when ETAt exceeds MIN(visbrk*tmp3,WAVEMAKER_visbrk*tmp3) else nu_bkg (L2539-2543), tmp3=SQRT(GRAV*MAX(MinDepthFrc,H)) (L2508). (13) IRREGULAR_LEFT_BC (L2560-2623, 09/12/2017): on the west boundary (n_west==MPI_PROC_NULL guard L2590) reconstructs Eta/U/V time series in the Nghost ghost columns from Cm_eta..Sm_v with RTIME=TIME+(ISTAGE-1)*DT/3 (L2586), sets HU/HV=(Depth+ETA)*U/V (L2614-2615). (14) WK_NEW_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA (L2636-2796, Salatin 2021): per-frequency single-direction source with goto-based angle relaxation (labels 1001/10001, decrementing Theta_temp by 0.001 when no discrete angle fits, L2670-2731), logs Freq/Dire/PBC Dire/Amplitude/Phase (L2738-2752), source parameters as in (2) (L2777-2783). (15) WK_NEW_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE (L2813-3032, Salatin 2021): equal-df analytic spectrum with single direction per frequency assigned by alternating index formula theta(kf)=(-1_SP)**real(kf)*(-pi/2+pi*floor(ktheta_temp/2-0.5)/(mtheta-1))+theta_input (L2864-2875), AG wrapped-normal (L2876-2884), coherence percentage alpha_c clamped to [0,100] and applied via WAVE_COHERENCE (L2891-2897), correction_coeff=Ef/dot_product(AG,EnergyBin) calibrating AG (L2914-2920), per-kf source terms with goto 1000/1002 periodic angle relaxation (L2946-3013), D_gen(kf,1) (L3019-3021). (16) CALCULATE_NEW_Cm_Sm (L3047-3170, Salatin 2021): counts distinct frequencies into loop_index (L3070-3086, prints 'Number of distinct freqs' L3088-3094), then accumulates Cm/Sm collapsing repeated (coherent) frequencies into kf_temp=kf-kkk slots (L3096-3167) so components moved to a host frequency add within one Cm/Sm layer. (17) WAVE_COHERENCE (L3184-3299, Salatin 2021): Num_Coherent=alpha_c/100*mfreq (L3213); builds host frequency indices spaced by mtheta via implied-do array constructors (L3217-3233), candidate pool excluding hosts (L3237-3248), then randomly picks candidates (candidate_freq_idx=ceiling(rand()*mfreq_temp) L3257-3262), shrinks the pool with PACK (L3266-3273), moves each candidate to the nearest higher host frequency (freq_diff/MINLOC MASK .GT. 0 L3276-3279) rewriting Freq_temp (L3281-3285) and counting repetitions until COUNT(repetitions.GT.1)>=Num_Coherent (L3287-3295); Freq=Freq_temp (L3296). Preprocessor branches: PARALLEL, CARTESIAN, INTEL/CRAY rand variants throughout.

verbatim_spans.text: ! it turns out this part is a redefinition of Yc_WK, remove it (07/08/2016)
!  cannot deallocate phase2d, I could not find any reason why cannot.
! here should convert Hmo to Hrms
! here I use fixed C_phase and wave_length to determine beta_gen
! as suggested by Wei and Kirby 1999
! user can specify the degree of coherency by specifying alpha_c in input FILE

unresolved: WAVEMAKER_INITIALIZATION WK_REG periodic scan: after the loop Theta_WK=tmp3 @L186; tmp3 was set to 90.0/-90.0 on failure paths @L118/L156 but those also MPI_FINALIZE/STOP — control flow after MPI_FINALIZE without STOP in parallel branch (@L97,L122,L145,L157,L168) continues executing on non-zero ranks; behavior depends on MPI runtime

WK_DATA2D phase input: label 109 'INPUT_WAVE_PHASE = .TRUE.' @L229 is fall-through (no GOTO 109 exists); reaching L229 requires completing the Phase2D read loop, END=110 @L214 skips it — the flag is effectively set only when phase data present; label 109 itself is never referenced
Phase2D deallocation deliberately skipped (comment L339-342 'deallocation will cause minor discontinuity at processor interface') and again @L560-562 — reason unresolved in source

CALCULATE_TMA_Cm_Sm and CALCULATE_TMA_Cm_Sm_EQUAL_DFREQ allocate Amp_Ser/Wave_Number_Ser/... and Cm_eta..Sm_v (@L1231-1238, @L1575-1582) without checking prior allocation — repeated wavemaker initialization would double-allocate; not resolvable here

WK_WAVEMAKER_IRREGULAR_WAVE PERIODIC block modifies the loop-shared scalar Theta (@L2077 'Theta = tmp3') inside the kf/ktheta double loop after the WHILE scans use tmp2 from the last iteration (@L2048,L2061 use tmp2 outside its defining loop); for mtheta>1 the snapped angle of one component becomes the input of the next — cross-line dependency L2033-2077

in WK_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA non-CARTESIAN branches use DY(I,J) @L695,@L716 with global loop indices I,J from PARAM/GLOBAL that are not loop variables of this routine (loops use nfre/ndir); DY(1,1) is used elsewhere (@L662,@L730) — likely stale indices, cannot confirm intent

CALCULATE_TMA_Cm_Sm 10000-bin equal-energy selection comments note known defects: 'inaccuracy caused by 100 freq if mfreq<100' @L1277-1278, Freq=0 patch @L1303-1306, Freq(mfreq)<Freq(mfreq-1) random-number patch @L1308-1315 — root cause left open by authors

VISCOSITY_WMAKER dummy args DX,DY appear in both CARTESIAN (@L2499) and array (@L2501) declarations via preprocessor; ETAT in the argument list @L2484 vs declaration spelled ETAt @L2503 (case-insensitive); H unused beyond tmp3 @L2508 and ETA (global) vs ETAt (argument) both referenced @L2538-2539 — which surface elevation governs the threshold vs cap1 differs by one time level, intent unresolved

WK_NEW_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE: width uses wave_length left from the last kf loop iteration (@L3030) after recomputing wkn at fm (@L3029) but not recomputing wave_length/C_phase from it (unlike @L2099-2100 which also omits C_phase but earlier variants @L2465-2469 recompute) — width may not correspond to peak-period wavelength

WAVE_COHERENCE: allocatable host_freqs_idx/host_freqs/temp_idx/freq_diff assigned via array constructors and expressions (@L3218-3233,@L3235,@L3276-3277) relying on F2003 automatic allocation; final DEALLOCATE commented out @L3297-3298; DO WHILE @L3255 termination for alpha_c=100 depends on pool exhaustion before Num_Coherent reached — no explicit guard against empty candidate_freq_pool

CALCULATE_NEW_Cm_Sm allocates loop_index (@L3077) without deallocation or prior-allocation check; called once per wavemaker init — repeated calls would fail; also kf loop @L3120 assumes coherent (equal-Freq) components are adjacent after WAVE_COHERENCE moves, which holds only because moved components adopt exactly a host frequency value

the two SHOW_BREAKING branches set T_brk differently: WK_DATA2D/WK_TIME use T_brk=WAVE_COMP(NumWaveComp,1) @L336,@L362 (a period from data), WK_IRR uses T_brk=1.0_SP/FreqMax @L410,@L605, WK_NEW_DATA2D uses T_brk=Freq(FreqCount) @L558 (a frequency, not a period) — dimensional inconsistency at L558 unresolved
